column1: # Module 08 — how the web works. Format: Text<TAB>tags. Card law: anki/CARD-RULES.md
Page-load journey: {{c1::URL → DNS → TCP → TLS → HTTP → edge/gate/origin → response → render}} — repeated per asset.
URL anatomy: {{c1::scheme://host/path?query}}.
DNS turns {{c1::names into IP addresses}}; by hand: {{c2::nslookup}}.
www.leedspunjabisociety.com is answered by {{c1::Cloudflare's IPs — the edge, not the Vercel origin}}.
TCP = {{c1::a reliable, ordered, two-way pipe to a numbered port}} — 443 for HTTPS.
TLS gives {{c1::secrecy (encryption)}} + {{c2::identity (certificate)}}.
HSTS commits the browser to {{c1::HTTPS-only for max-age seconds}}.
Status families: 2xx {{c1::worked}} · 3xx {{c2::go elsewhere}} · 4xx {{c3::you erred}} · 5xx {{c4::server erred}}.
307/308 vs 301/302 — the 7/8 promise: {{c1::the method won't change on redirect}}.
Site redirects: vercel.app → {{c1::308 permanent}}; /dashboard logged-out → {{c2::307 temporary}}.
The Age header is the tell of {{c1::a cache hit — seconds on the edge shelf, origin never woke}}.
Session-cookie flags: {{c1::HttpOnly (scripts can't read)}} · {{c2::Secure (HTTPS only)}} · {{c3::SameSite (no cross-site rides)}}.
Re-check auth AFTER the gate because {{c1::forged requests skip gates — the check beside the data can't be skipped}}.
CDN = {{c1::cache servers near users answering for the origin}}.
The site's serving chain: {{c1::Cloudflare (DNS + edge cache)}} in front of {{c2::Vercel (Next.js origin)}}.
The header that revealed the backend: {{c1::CSP connect-src *.supabase.co}}.
X-Frame-Options: DENY defends against {{c1::clickjacking}}.
curl flags: -I {{c1::headers only (HEAD)}} · -L {{c2::follow redirects}} · -v {{c3::narrate the conversation}}.
Docs said vercel.app, the wire said custom domain: {{c1::trust the wire — docs drift, evidence doesn't}}.
